vibe_rationale: One of the largest tattoo conventions in the world, with concerts on top; a real community core but a mass-scale expo-hall format.
fit_notes: Large tattoo and urban crowd with a clear but narrow aftercare and skin-care adjacency; concerts widen reach. The 70,000 figure is the 2025 organiser count. Two listed partners and a partnership page with contact email, while 650 exhibitors buy stand space. Paid stands are the likely entry point at a high cost. Brazil-based.
